reply_text:
Gideon, I've replied in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Your first report in the channel was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, saying both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan. In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo added that six trucks were waiting at the east gate. Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03, and you confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

One caveat: ticket SUP-5380 has an update log entry at 08:12 that day saying the reboot failed and drivers were queuing. That is earlier than your 10:42 message, and I can't tell who logged it or whether it was reported earlier. Check the ticket before you cite 10:42 as the first report.
